title: Discovering Japan | A Journey from Sacred Shrines to Futuristic Skylines
highlights: Explore Japan’s rich tapestry, where Tokyo’s dynamic cityscapes, Kyoto’s heritage, Hiroshima’s history, and Osaka’s lively streets offer an unforgettable experience.
Stand at the edge of the clouds at the 5th Station of Mt. Fuji, where the sweeping views of the Fuji Five Lakes and surrounding valley paint a picture of breathtaking beauty.
Walk around the Atomic Bomb Dome and witness the ruins of the tragic Atomic Bomb incident that still stands as a testament to the strength of the people of Hiroshima.
Observe the iconic Sika deer in Nara Park, known for their friendly and calm nature, as they graze and wander through the park's ancient temples and stunning gardens.
Explore the streets of Shinsekai, where you can try local food, from deep-fried skewers to traditional takoyaki, in a neighbourhood that feels like stepping into a vintage Osaka.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to the hotel. After checking in, you can explore the city at your own pace. You may visit Ginza, a lively area known for its high-end shopping options. Alternatively, you may spend time at Sumida Park, a peaceful escape from the city's rush. For a cultural experience, you can visit Samurai Theatre & enjoy live performances, or stroll across the iconic Rainbow Bridge, which offers views of Tokyo Bay, among other attractions.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour by Bus
days.desc: Head to LOVE Sculpture & board the transfer for Tokyo City Tour. Begin with a visit Meiji Jingu Shrine, known for its calm ambience. Next, explore Imperial Palace, the seat of Japan's imperial family, followed by a visit to Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo's oldest temple. Continue to Tokyo Skytree, offering city views from its observation deck. Conclude the tour in Odaiba, a district full of entertainment options. Later, get driven 1-chōme-7-2 Nishishinjuku. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From LOVE Statue with Lunch

days.title: Excursion to Mt. Fuji- 5th Station & Hakone
days.desc: From your hotel, head to Giulio Paolini Sculpture: "Kaleidoscorpio" & board the transfer to Mt. Fuji, Japan’s iconic peak. Upon reaching 5th Station, enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. Next, take Hakone Ropeway ride, which offers views of Lake Ashi & Mt. Fuji as you ascend towards Owakudani Valley, an active volcanic area famous for its sulfur vents. Later, get driven to Odawara Station to board Shinkansen bullet train to Tokyo. From there, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, you can relax at your hotel or explore Tokyo at your leisure. You can visit Street Kart Tokyo Bay, where you can try thrilling go-karts through the city's streets. Alternatively, take a peaceful stroll through Sumida Park, offering views of Tokyo Skytree. In the afternoon, you may visit Shinjuku Gyoen, a serene garden with lovely ponds & walking paths, or head to Tokyo Disneyland, which offers exciting rides & shows for visitors of all ages, among other famous places.

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post-checkout, head to Tokyo Station on your own to board the bullet train to Hiroshima. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel. Later, you can spend your day at leisure. You can visit Shukkeien Garden, designed in a circuit style with a central pond, hills, tea houses, and bridges. Alternatively, you can visit Hiroshima Castle, also known as the "Carp Castle," where you can explore its beautiful grounds and climb to the top for panoramic views of the city, among famous points.

days.title: Hiroshima & Miyajima Island Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Get ready & head to the pickup point- Hotel Granvia for Miyajima & Hiroshima tour. Begin the journey with a visit to Peace Memorial Park, reflecting the powerful message of peace. Next, visit Atomic Bomb Dome, offering insight into the devastating history of atomic bomb incident. Then, board the ferry & get driven to Miyajima Island to visit Itsukushima Shrine, where you'll witness the famous torii gates. Later, get driven back to Hiroshima Station. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Take the day to explore the city on your own. You can visit the Hiroshima Botanical Garden, featuring over 1,000 species of plants or the Hiroshima Museum of Art which showcases a stunning collection of European & Japanese artwork. Also, you may witness the Yamato battleship, providing a fascinating insight into World War II history at the Yamato Museum, which offers an intriguing look into Japan’s maritime history, among other famous places.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After you check out, head to Tokyo Station to take the bullet train to Kyoto. Upon arriving, head to the hotel on your own. Post check in, relax for some time. Later, you can explore the city on your own. You can visit Nijo Castle, famed for its nightingale floors. Alternatively, you may visit Kyoto National Museum, home to various traditional arts & samurai armours. You can also explore International Manga Museum, where you can find various manga comics.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)

days.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Explore the highlights of Kyoto & Nara on a sightseeing tour. Begin by boarding the transfer from Kyoto Station & travel to the first spot- Kinkakuji Temple, famous for its stunning gold leaf exterior. Next, explore Arashiyama District & stroll through the iconic bamboo forest & lush landscapes. Conclude with a visit to Nara Park where you can interact with the playful Sika deer & spend time at Todai-ji Temple. Later, get driven to Kyoto Station. From there head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Full-Day Tour to Kyoto & Nara - Kyoto Departure/Buffet Lunch

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Make the most of your time in Kyoto & explore the city at your own pace. You can visit Rurikō-in Temple, offering a peaceful escape from the city's rush or spend time at Kiyomizu-dera, offering panoramic city views. If you wish, you can explore the Gion district, famous for its geisha culture & traditional wooden houses or witness the spanning Katsura River from the iconic Togetsukyo Bridge, among other famous places.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After you check out from the hotel, head to Hiroshima Station to board the bullet train to Osaka. Upon arrival, head to the hotel on your own & check in. Later, you can explore the city at your own pace. You can visit Osaka Castle, a striking symbol of Japan's feudal era or stroll through Den Den Town where you can shop & try amazing food & entertainment options. You can also relax at Spa World, offering various rejuvenating sessions, among other famous places.

items.title: Osaka Museum Of Housing And Living
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the meeting point, Osaka Tourist Information Center on your own for Osaka walking tour. Begin by wandering Shinsekai & Hozenji Yokocho streets. There, you can try traditional Japanese food. Next, visit Hozenji Temple, known for its Fudo Myoo statue. Then, head to Dotonbori, famous for its vibrant ambience. Conclude your journey at Ebisu Bridge, where you can admire the colourful lights of Dotonbori. Later, you can explore Osaka on your own, before you unwind for the day.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: In the morning, get ready for a day of thrills at Universal Studios Japan, featuring ten immersive zones. Upon arrival, take on Hollywood Dream—The Ride, a roller coaster that simulates the feeling of flying. You can also wander through Minion Park, where you can meet the mischievous Minions in a whimsical world of fun. You may also brace yourself for a wild ride through Jurassic Park, where you’ll encounter thrilling dinosaurs, among other experiences. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, take the day to explore Osaka at your leisure. You can visit Miraiza Osaka-Jo, offering a mix of shops, cafes, & restaurants. Alternatively, you can visit Abeno Harukas, the tallest skyscraper in Japan, which offers stunning views of the Osaka skyline. If you wish, you can also visit teamLab Botanical Garden which lets you enjoy an innovative fusion of nature and technology, among other famous attraction points.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Reflect on the amazing experiences you've enjoyed in Japan & after breakfast, check out from the hotel. Later, you'll be driven to the airport to board your flight back home. This is where your trip ends.
